findings.highlight: I have to get her to go home
findings.evidenceJa: 帰さないと危なっかしくてしょうがない
findings.governingReading: I have to send her home soon; otherwise I cannot stop worrying about her safety
findings.explanation: Shirou’s anxious protectiveness toward Rin disappears, leaving only the practical need to make her leave.

findings.governingReading: my freshly bathed skin
findings.explanation: A tactile image of winter air cooling bare post-bath skin becomes an unsupported claim about whole-body warmth.

findings.governingReading: a hanten, a padded house jacket
findings.explanation: The specific short padded garment Shirou thinks of buying for cold trips across the grounds becomes a generic outdoor coat.

findings.highlight: we don’t have time to be playing around
findings.evidenceJa: のんびりしてる暇ない
findings.governingReading: you do not have time to dawdle
findings.explanation: Shirou’s complaint about lingering becomes an accusation that Rin is frivolously playing.

findings.governingReading: that ramshackle thing—the shed
findings.explanation: Rin contemptuously refers to the whole ramshackle storehouse; the English narrows the description to its door.

findings.evidenceJa: しまった、と舌打ちする
findings.governingReading: She clicks her tongue at her mistake
findings.explanation: Rin’s irritated tongue-click becomes a different gesture suggesting anxiety or restraint.

findings.highlight: surprise attacks coming from unexpected places
findings.governingReading: surprise attacks outside her calculations
findings.explanation: A figurative failure to anticipate Shirou’s verbal trap becomes an attack arriving from a spatially unexpected location.

findings.governingReading: you have no awareness of what you are doing
findings.explanation: Rin means Shirou does not recognize the abnormality of his own method; “self-conscious” instead suggests social embarrassment.

findings.governingReading: without a formal procedure or even an abbreviated one
findings.explanation: A technical abbreviated ritual or method becomes the abstract act of making something simpler.

findings.highlight:
put you in
 formalin along with your brain
findings.evidenceJa: ガラス蓋付きの標本箱にピンで飾られる
findings.governingReading: pin you for display in a glass-lidded specimen case
findings.explanation: One conditional English variant invents preservation in formalin “along with your brain,” replacing Rin’s threat of being pinned as a specimen.

findings.evidenceJa: ブレス：ごくり、と息を飲む
findings.governingReading: Voice direction: audibly swallow / gulp
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates an inactive Japanese performance note as first-person narration, adding a displayed line absent from the original script.

findings.highlight: there’s no humor in her voice at all
findings.evidenceJa: 冗談にしか聞こえない
findings.governingReading: sounds like nothing but a joke
findings.explanation: One English conditional says Rin does not sound humorous, reversing the contrast: her words sound like a joke but are in fact completely serious.

findings.highlight: if we change your process just a bit
findings.evidenceJa: 少し手順を変えてあげるだけで
findings.governingReading: if I merely adjust your procedure a little for you
findings.explanation: Rin’s proposal that she personally alter Shirou’s method becomes an unspecified collective effort.

findings.governingReading: every single thing you say is reasonable
findings.explanation: Shirou concedes the full logic of each point; “plausible” treats the argument as merely possible.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to do it again
findings.governingReading: I probably cannot do it again
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertainty about reproducing the feat becomes categorical inability.

findings.highlight: you should be able to do it anytime
findings.governingReading: make it your own—master it
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to turn any achieved result into a learned skill becomes an unsupported claim of immediate anytime repeatability.

findings.governingReading: magecraft we cannot reproduce
findings.explanation: Failure to reproduce particular workings becomes inability to use magic at all, while magecraft is again generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: getting all the required materials from within you
findings.evidenceJa: 材料を全部内界から出してきてる
findings.governingReading: drawing every required material from your inner world
findings.explanation: The technical contrast between external world and inner world is reduced to bodily location, encouraging the very misunderstanding Shirou makes on the next page.

findings.highlight: there shouldn’t be any magic that’s impossible for you
findings.evidenceJa: アンタが生きてる限り
findings.governingReading: for as long as you remain alive
findings.explanation: The explicit duration and existential condition on Rin’s repeatability claim disappear.

findings.governingReading: Rin lets out an exaggerated sigh
findings.explanation: The performative excess in Rin’s exasperation disappears.

findings.governingReading: it gets under my skin
findings.explanation: A brief prick of irritation becomes much coarser, stronger anger in Shirou’s voice.

findings.governingReading: is properly late at night
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conservative judgment that after nine counts as deep night becomes a comparison to the exact hour midnight.

findings.highlight: not self-conscious that she’s a girl
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が女の子だって自覚がない
findings.governingReading: not aware that she is a girl
findings.explanation: Awareness of the fact grounding Shirou’s protective norm again becomes social self-consciousness.

findings.governingReading: Hurry up and come here
findings.explanation: Rin’s direct instruction to hurry is reduced to a generic summons.
